subject.why: The vintage car and strapped suitcase are clearly depicted and recognizable.

category.why: The car rests on grounded terrain with a suitable garden backdrop.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: Centered composition with adequate breathing room around the edges.

colour.why: Vibrant and saturated palette with clear separation between car and background.

detail.why: The gravel driveway and hedge foliage feature dense, repetitive pebble and leaf micro-textures.

style.why: The environment relies on granular surface noise rather than the smooth, simplified forms of the references.

fix: Simplify the driveway and hedge textures into smooth, chunky stylized planes consistent with the reference cards.
